notes: Product list (firstapp.views.product_list, templates/products/product_list.html) of a small fashion/perfume shop, run on Django 4.1 + SQLite from a copy with no source changes. 12 formal Arabic products seeded via the ORM (the repo's own DB had 3 items - perfumes, clothes, bags - with hot-linked Bing/Blogspot images and one 45345.00 test price). Product.image_url is a URLField, so the PIL-generated placeholder images are served by the same local runserver from firstapp/static/products/ in the copy. Captured with the installed Chrome via Playwright at a 1400x875 viewport scaled to 2240x1400, because at 1120px the template's fixed 18rem cards overlap inside the 4-column grid (also checked: that overlap is the project's own behaviour, not a capture fault). Doubts: the navbar buttons read 'Rigester' / 'Loing' (typos in the real template, left untouched) and descriptions are cut with a leading ellipsis by Bootstrap text-truncate on an LTR page.
